summary: Done: Editor merge commit c0970d6fd2fd50a04c1aecdfb4a394440636108a records a bounded large Structure performance gate. The gate adds a replayable synthetic smoke script, fixture, and Vitest assertions for 100, 1000, and 5000 visible text-block structures. The 1000-node hard gate recorded render projection 7.527ms, add-action projection 62.878ms, selection plus zoom projection 0.126ms, Structure render 89.266ms, 66298 Structure markup bytes, and 61 rendered Structure rows. The 5000-node scenario recorded render projection 11.183ms, add-action projection 143.814ms, Structure render 117.022ms, 66492 Structure markup bytes, and remains exploratory. This does not enable WYSIWYG behavior, contenteditable runtime, browser visual readiness, accessibility readiness, broad frontend readiness, product truth, or map truth.
